title: Max, two shapes
prompt: Implement two overloads: `static int Max(int a, int b)` and `static int Max(int[] values)`. The array version returns the largest element and **throws `ArgumentException`** for null or empty input — never a fake sentinel value.

tests.name: scalar
tests.hint: Larger wins; equal arguments return that value.

tests.name: array
tests.hint: Scan every element; negatives must not trip an initial-maximum bug.

tests.name: empty-throws
tests.hint: No data is not a data problem you can guess around — it's a contract violation. Throw.
